Plot residual correlations or precisions from a mvgam_residcor object

Source: R/mvgam_residcor-class.R
plot.mvgam_residcor.Rd

Heatmap of the residual correlations or partial correlations from a Joint Species Distribution (jsdgam) or dynamic factor (mvgam) model.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'mvgam_residcor'
plot(
  x,
  type = c("correlation", "precision"),
  cluster = FALSE,
  rescale = FALSE,
  ...
)

Arguments

x

A mvgam_residcor object returned by residual_cor(..., summary = TRUE).

type

Character. Which matrix to plot. "correlation" (the default) draws x$cor. "precision" draws x$prec, the partial correlations (Ovaskainen et al. 2016). residual_cor() computes them under partial = TRUE.

cluster

Logical. When TRUE, the matrix is reordered by an approximate Robinson ordering (Gruvaeus & Wainer 1972; average linkage on the 1 - cormat distance). Clusters of positive and negative correlations then lie adjacent. Defaults to FALSE.

rescale

Logical. By default colour spans [-1, 1], the full range of a correlation. Panels from different fits are then comparable. A correlation of 0.4 looks unlike one of 1. Set TRUE to scale colour to the entries present, for a fit whose correlations are all small. Defaults to FALSE.

...

Unused. Anything passed here is refused.

Value

A ggplot object.

Details

Only the lower triangle of off-diagonal entries is drawn; a symmetric matrix says everything once and the diagonal is 1 for any correlation. Fill shows the posterior point estimate. A black outline marks each pair whose credible interval excludes zero. summary.mvgam_residcor() reports each pair's interval and prob_nonzero.

See also

residual_cor(), summary.mvgam_residcor()
